physiology:
The traditions seat this code in the perineum, the floor of the body, the low platform the spine rests on and the rest of the organism is hung from. It is the deepest pelvic ground, the place where weight finally stops travelling and is held. The adrenal glands sit not far above, the small caps on the kidneys that pour out the chemistry of pressure, the press to move, the press to do something about the way things are. Together they form the body's seat of urge.

The shadow has its bodily floor here as a low hum that will not switch off. A standing-up restlessness. The legs want to be somewhere else before the mind has chosen where. Sleep does not quite settle. The adrenals keep ticking out a small quantity of go, go, go, and the body lives with a faint background pressure that the next thing is the thing.

The climb out is also bodily, and it happens lower than thought. The pelvis softens. Weight comes back down through the feet. The breath drops past the chest and lands in the belly. The urge does not vanish, the life force has not been dimmed, but it stops being aimed forward into a future and begins to sit. It is felt as warmth in the floor of the body, a steady low brightness that does not need anywhere to go. The aliveness was always here, and the body knew it before the rest of you did.
amino_acid:
Deeper than the organ, this code answers to a single amino acid, Serine. Serine is one of the small set the body can make for itself, built quietly from what is already on hand, never needing to be carried in from outside. The body has not waited for permission. The chemistry was running before you noticed.

There is a teaching in that, and it fits this card. The dissatisfaction has been hunting outside for something the body has been quietly producing all along. Serine is also a feeder for other things: it lends itself to the building of glycine, of cysteine, of the chemistry the brain uses to make calm and lift mood. A small letter, busy underneath everything, making the larger work possible.

The code runs all the way down to this. The very source of the seeking is built on an element the body never needed to look for. The fuel for the joy was already being made, in the dark, under the floor of attention, while the chase was on for it everywhere else.
